tournament.assignment: Desk's rotation rule assigns; this campaign observes and audits. Dispenses lacking a {provider, selection_reason, ts} stamp are OBSERVATIONAL only (rule 5).
tournament.window_rule: first 24 stamped dispatches OR 2026-12-01, whichever first; per-arm reporting only at n>=4/arm
tournament.cull_rule: arm with first-pass success < pooled - 0.25 at n>=8 is flagged; doe-expert proposes a desk-rule amendment (the desk owns its rule; this campaign issues the verdict, not the change)
tournament.desk_rotation_rule: Bench-wide TASK-FIT rotation (owner FIX via main, 2026-11-01; supersedes the no-2-consecutive rule): every dispatch selects from the FULL wired bench in this catalog — the surface whose class fits the task (build / fix / review / device / probe / inference arm) — with no fixed funnel and no automatic repeat of the previous pick. Stamps carry provider + selection reason + bench position (the provider's catalog class).

activation_gates: AGENTROUTER_API_KEY is present in approved secret storage and is never exposed in records
native inference transport is separately reviewed and allowlisted; catalog registration is not inference admission
explicit spend ceiling and stop switch are approved
data classification and provider data-handling terms are reviewed
conditional_provider_arms.activation_rule: Activate only after every listed activation gate passes. The first real desk-stamped dispatch is required as post-activation evidence before the arm is counted or scored; a registry/catalog row alone is not an eligible inference arm.
